node.name: compliance: fedramp-20x
node.description: The FedRAMP 20x compliance dimension. All TAP-managed types from the FedRAMP 20x KSI plugin are tagged with {"compliance": "fedramp-20x"} as their default dimension. This dimension covers the Key Security Indicator (KSI) catalog defined by the FedRAMP 20x program: top-level KSI themes (KSI-ABF, KSI-CHM, KSI-CNA, KSI-CYE, KSI-IAM, KSI-INC, KSI-MLA, KSI-POI, KSI-RCP, KSI-SVC, KSI-SCR as of April 2026) and the individual indicators within each theme, with applicable FedRAMP impact baselines (low, moderate) and source-faithful validation criteria. The `compliance` dimension key is intended as the shared root for all compliance-framework plugins; future frameworks such as NIST 800-53 and ISO 27001 should use the same key with their own value. This plugin is maintained at github.com/notgeorge/tap-plugin-fedramp-20x-ksi and integrated into TAP as a git submodule.
